title: rxdiag EMULATED HW topology: Firefly(cc2538) root + nRF52840 leaf, sync-vs-raw-async RX over TSCH

test.description: Emulates the exact hardware pairing: node 1 = Firefly (cc2538) rxdiag-root (RPL root + TSCH coordinator, sender); node 2 = nRF52840 rxdiag-leaf (node under test) running BOTH a simple_udp sync listener ([SU]) and a raw udp_conn tcpip_event listener ([RAW], coap-uip-like). On the leaf's trigger the root sweeps sizes {700..1000} to both leaf ports. This is the emulator BASELINE the hardware runs are compared against.
